title: Category of integer-graded left module sheaves
statement: Fix the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $(C,J)$ be a site essentially small in the coefficient universe $w$ and let $S$ be a sheaf of commutative rings in that universe. Write $\operatorname{Gr}(S)$ for the category of families $(N^n)_{n\in\mathbf Z}$ of $S$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with degree-zero families of $S$-linear sheaf maps. Its convolution tensor has degree $q$ equal to $\bigoplus_{i+j=q}N^i\otimes_S P^j$, using the sheaf tensor of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and unit $S$ concentrated in degree zero. A graded $S$-algebra is an associative unital monoid for this tensor. For such an algebra $B$, define $\operatorname{GrMod}(B)$ to have objects arbitrary integer-graded $S$-module sheaves $N$ with associative unital $S$-linear left action $B^i\otimes_S N^j\to N^{i+j}$, and maps the action-preserving degree-zero maps. No differential is part of its objects or maps. For a sheaf dg algebra $A$ of [def-sfb-sheaf-dg-module-localization], its underlying graded algebra is obtained by forgetting the differential while retaining its multiplication and unit. Thus $\operatorname{Gr}(A)$ means $\operatorname{GrMod}(A^\sharp)$.
